result.narrative:
Kessler Traders GmbH is showing cash-flow strain on two fronts at once. Three invoices are open with Adlerhof Trade Credit for EUR 189,100, the worst of them (INV001567, EUR 86,900) at 25 days past due against 45-day terms, and a Trade Ledger report dated 2026-09-20 describes workers at the Essen facility protesting over delayed wages, with union representatives warning of further action. The payment file is labelled "improving" — days-late fell from 46 and 55 days on the two oldest settled invoices to 10 days on the most recent — but that read rests on only three settled invoices and is contradicted by the only live position.

The score is 47.7, placing the buyer in the Watch band: 0.65 x 33.3 (payment, 25 DPD) + 0.35 x 74.3 (news) = 47.7, with PD at 0.3767. The severity-5 unpaid-wages article contributes 26.0 of the 47.7. The adjudicator agreed with caveats: the two inputs are not independent — delayed payroll and a past-due invoice describe the same strain — so 47.7 likely sits at the conservative end of what the evidence implies. The adjudicator also flagged that the news component rests on a single two-sentence, uncorroborated article which will decay with age (base 75.0, already 74.29 at 5 days), so the buyer will drift back toward Healthy automatically even if the wage arrears are never cleared.

The recommendation is to REDUCE the Adlerhof Trade Credit line from EUR 430,000 to EUR 285,373, cutting expected loss from EUR 131,205 to EUR 87,075 and aligning exposure with the 25% appetite target against a PD of 0.3767. The revised limit still sits above the EUR 189,100 currently owed. The adjudicator separately urges refreshing the line regardless of band: it has not been reviewed since 2024-10-24, and the undrawn headroom remains available to a buyer now showing both payroll distress and a past-due position.

The band would ease if the 25-day past-due item is settled and payroll status is actively confirmed clear rather than assumed from silence — news alone does not hold this buyer in Watch, and 12.7 points would return it to Healthy below 35.0. Against that, DPD reaching 37 days would carry the score to the High Risk line at 60.0, 12.3 points away.
